'''Nishrah''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] who was active around [[185 BBY]]. In this [[Standard year/Legends|year]] she traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] with fellow slavers [[Twool (Talz)|Twool]] and [[Lix]], hoping to capture a number of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] to sell. The group landed in the [[Shadowlands/Legends|Shadowlands]], the forest floor of Kashyyyk, where they encountered a group of young Wookiees led by [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. Hoping to catch the young group the slavers attacked, but were eventually beaten by the group. Twool and Nishrah were captured when adult Wookiees arrived in the Shadowlands and Lix was killed while trying to escape.<ref name="CSS" />
